methods.name: DemDet (DEM and hillshade-based landslide detection)
methods.summary: A multimodal deep learning model that uses hillshade maps, optical images, and DEM to identify forested landslides. It features a geometric feature extraction module for DEM, a transformer-based encoder (SegFormer) for hillshade and optical image feature extraction, and an attention-based decoder for multimodal feature fusion.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes DEM and hillshade-based landslide detection (DemDet), a new deep neural network for detecting forested landslides.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the custom DemDet code is not provided. Other input datasets are not linked or accessible.
